title: 13th BAFTA Awards (1960) — Best Film: Ben-Hur
t: 13th BAFTA Awards (1960) — Best Film: Ben-Hur
description:
13th BAFTA Awards — held 1960 at London.

The top honor, Best Film, went to Ben-Hur. Wyler's epic took Best Film at the 13th BAFTAs, mirroring its Oscar triumph.

Early BAFTAs split Best Film into British and 'from any source' categories; Ben-Hur won the top international prize.

This ceremony belongs to the British Academy of Film and Television Arts's long arc from its founding to the present: each year's winners capture what the British valued most — the films, records, shows, and books that defined their moment.
